scopeRule: Exported funcs and methods of the packages that hold each workflow, unioned across every released API file. Consts, vars, and type declarations are configuration or shape, not operations; they stay counted in excludedDeclarations so the exclusion cannot hide a gap.

core.mem.reason: memory layout lives behind the unsafe package, which Go does not present as an ordinary API

core.web.reason: net/http answers core.http; Go ships no web framework

core.env.reason: environment access lives in the os package, recorded under core.os

core.fmt.reason: formatting lives in the fmt package, recorded under core.io

core.text.reason: text handling lives in the strings package, recorded under String

Set.reason: no Go standard-library set type; the idiom is map[T]struct{}

Cache.reason: no Go standard-library cache with an eviction policy
